description: §6.7.3 — the `cleanup()` argument is a non-function value (an integer literal). Same family as E-LIFECYCLE-002 but covering non-call non-function shapes (bare values, object literals).
rationale: §6.7.3 normative + §34: `cleanup()` requires one function argument; a literal, array or object cannot be invoked at teardown. Resolution: pass an arrow function or a function reference.
